# `cmp_generate` arguments

Mirrors the cmpose generator's contract (`@cmpose/core` 1.0.0, served by the local cmpose MCP
server). **At runtime, always prefer `cmp_describe`'s `contract.limits` over the static numbers below.**

## Tools
- MCP server: `claude mcp add cmpose -- npx -y @cmpose/mcp@1.0.0` (Node.js 20+ and git; restart Claude Code after adding it).
- `cmp_describe` (no arguments) → `{ contractVersion, coreVersion, mcpVersion, template: { repo, ref }, defaults, contract }`.
- `cmp_generate` → writes `<outputDir>/<projectName>` on this machine and returns `structuredContent`
  `{ projectDir, template: { repo, ref, commit }, templateType, features, featuresConfig, warnings, nextSteps }`.
  - A refused request returns an error result (`isError`) whose text is the reason: one of the validation
    messages below, `<dir> already exists and is not empty`, `Unknown featuresConfig key(s): …`, or a template
    download error (the first run downloads the pinned template).
  - It never overwrites a non-empty folder and never leaves half a project behind.

## Body
```jsonc
{
  "outputDir": "/absolute/parent/folder", // absolute; the project goes to <outputDir>/<projectName>
  "projectName": "MyApp",            // ^[a-zA-Z]+$  · ≤30 · no spaces
  "appName": "My App",               // letters/digits/space . _ ' - · trimmed · ≤30
  "packageName": "com.example.myapp", // ^[a-z][a-z0-9]*(\.[a-z][a-z0-9]*){2,}$ · ≤50 · ≥3 segments · no Kotlin keyword segments · not com.kturker.multiplatform or under it
  "minSdk": "24",                    // numeric string (1–2 digits) in [24..36]
  "iosVersion": "15.0",              // ^\d+(\.\d+){1,2}$ in [15.0..26.2]
  "templateType": "blank",           // "blank" | "showcase"
  "ci": false,                       // GitHub Actions CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml: pull requests + manual runs); every template; default false
  "featuresConfig": {                // used only for "blank"; ignored for "showcase"
    "network": true,
    "networkInspector": true,        // requires network=true
    "networkBaseUrl": "",            // optional; http(s) URL if non-empty · no whitespace, " \ $ · ≤100
    "theming": true,
    "multiLang": true,
    "dataStore": true,               // auto-true if theming || multiLang
    "detekt": true,
    "detektYamlContent": null,       // optional custom detekt.yml as a string
    "purchases": true,               // custom paywall on RevenueCat; ships a Test Store key — replace it before you ship
    "ads": true,                     // AdMob banner/interstitial/rewarded (Google test IDs) + UMP/ATT consent
    "room": false,                   // Room KMP database (core/room) + a Notes demo; only for a local database / offline storage, not preferences
    "backend": false                 // Ktor server (server/) + Firebase sign-in + spaces/sharing; implies multiLang + network
  },
  "features": ["profile"]            // custom modules · each ^[a-z][a-z0-9]*$ · ≤20 · count ≤ maxModules (3)
}
```

## Validation rules (mirror for fast feedback; cmp_generate's error is authoritative)
| Field | Rule | Max len |
|---|---|---|
| projectName | `^[a-zA-Z]+$`, no spaces | 30 |
| appName | non-empty, no leading/trailing space; only letters (any script, incl. combining marks), digits, space and `. _ ' -` | 30 |
| packageName | `^[a-z][a-z0-9]*(\.[a-z][a-z0-9]*){2,}$` (≥3 segments); no segment may be a Kotlin hard keyword (`kotlinHardKeywords`); must not equal or sit under the reserved template package `com.kturker.multiplatform` (`reservedPackagePrefix`) | 50 |
| module name | `^[a-z][a-z0-9]*$`; not a Kotlin hard keyword; not a reserved name (`build`, `monetization`, `notes`, `account`, `sharing`) | 20 |
| module count | ≤ `maxModules` (3) | — |
| minSdk | numeric string of 1–2 digits, in [24..36] | 2 |
| iosVersion | `^\d+(\.\d+){1,2}$` within [15.0..26.2] | 8 |
| networkBaseUrl | `http://` or `https://` only; no whitespace, `"`, `\`, `$`; checked only for blank + `network: true` + non-empty | 100 |

Kotlin hard keywords (`kotlinHardKeywords`): `as`, `break`, `class`, `continue`, `do`, `else`, `false`, `for`, `fun`, `if`, `in`, `interface`, `is`, `null`, `object`, `package`, `return`, `super`, `this`, `throw`, `true`, `try`, `typealias`, `typeof`, `val`, `var`, `when`, `while`.

## Always-on (not configurable, not in the payload)
- **Dependency Injection (Koin)** and **Navigation** are always included.

## Feature dependencies (enforce BEFORE sending)
- `networkInspector: true` ⇒ set `network: true`.
- `theming: true` or `multiLang: true` ⇒ set `dataStore: true`.
- `purchases` and `ads` are independent. With both on, an active premium entitlement hides the ads.
- `backend → multiLang, network`: `backend: true` ⇒ set `multiLang: true` and `network: true` (and so `dataStore: true`).

## Monetization (`purchases`, `ads`)
- `purchases` → `core/purchases` (RevenueCat KMP behind `PurchasesManager`: `offer()`, `purchase(packageId)`, `restore()`) + a custom Compose paywall and `FirstLaunchPaywall()` in `feature/monetization`.
  The project ships with a RevenueCat **Test Store** API key: replace it with your own platform keys
  before you ship to a store. A **release** build that still has the Test Store key keeps purchases
  disabled (the paywall shows a message instead of offerings).
- `ads` → `core/ads` (AdMob banner, interstitial and rewarded, with Google's test ad unit IDs) +
  an ads demo screen in `feature/monetization`. UMP consent (and ATT on iOS) is requested on the
  first visit to the ads screen, not at app launch; a real app should ask at launch. The EEA consent
  debug geography is applied in debug builds only.
- Either flag adds `feature/monetization`; `monetization` is therefore a reserved module name.

## Room (`room`)
- `room` → `core/room` (Room KMP with bundled SQLite: `AppDatabase`, DAOs, exported `schemas/`) and, in
  blank, a Notes demo screen in `feature/notes`. Showcase always has `core/room` (it stores the
  favorites) and never `feature/notes`. `notes` is therefore a reserved module name.
- Turn it on only when the user asks for a local database or offline storage of structured data.
  Preferences and settings belong in DataStore (`dataStore`). `room` is independent: it implies nothing.
- Notes is a demo: replace it or remove it. New tables go into the existing `AppDatabase`.

## Backend (`backend`)
- `backend` → a Ktor server in `server/`, generated from the cmpose backend template with sharing on and no sample
  feature (Firebase ID-token check; users, spaces, members, invites and files; Flyway migrations; tests on an embedded
  PostgreSQL; an included build, checked with `./gradlew :server:build`), `core/api` (the app's client models and
  routes for the backend API, checked against the server's API description by `ApiContractTest`), `core/auth`
  (Firebase sign-in: email, Google, Apple; the backend client's token), `feature/account` (sign-in, settings,
  account deletion) and `feature/sharing` (spaces, members, invites).
- Blank only: showcase ignores `featuresConfig` and never contains the server parts.
- Turn it on only when the user explicitly asks for a server/backend, sign-in, or sharing data with other users.
- Invite link: `<scheme>://invite/<token>`. `account` and `sharing` are therefore reserved module names.
- After generation: add your own Firebase config files (`google-services.json`, `GoogleService-Info.plist`; never
  commit them), put the same Firebase project's id in `.local-server/config.properties` (`firebaseProjectId=<id>`;
  `runLocal` stops without it), then start the local server from the project root with `./gradlew :server:runLocal`
  (an embedded PostgreSQL kept in `.local-server/`; `:server:resetLocal` deletes it). App data is added with the
  `cmp-backend` skill.

## Insights (`insights`)
- `insights` → `core/insights` (Firebase Crashlytics + Analytics behind `Insights`; Kermit warnings and errors go to
  Crashlytics). Blank only: showcase always has `core/insights`. `insights` is independent: it implies nothing.
- Turn it on only when the user explicitly asks for crash reporting or analytics (Crashlytics, Firebase/Google
  Analytics), not for an app that shows analytics.
- Without your own Firebase config files (`androidApp/google-services.json`, `iosApp/iosApp/GoogleService-Info.plist`;
  never commit them) the app builds and runs, and every `Insights` call is a no-op (`Insights.isEnabled == false`).
  The generator warns: "Crashlytics and Analytics stay off until you add the Firebase config files (README, Insights)."
- Nothing personal is sent: no tokens, bodies, headers, emails or names; `setUserId` takes the backend user id only.

## blank vs showcase
- **blank**: `featuresConfig` reflects the user's choices; `features` = custom modules
  (each name once; a duplicate is refused).
- **showcase**: send `templateType:"showcase"` and put any requested custom modules in
  `features` (`features: []` when none). The generator keeps the default `home` +
  `onboarding` modules and **ignores `featuresConfig`** (it strips any
  `home`/`onboarding` you put in `features`). Custom modules are added next to them,
  fully wired (their screens are registered; the showcase still opens on onboarding).

## Generator error messages (match these exactly when re-asking)
- `projectNameSpaces`: Project Name cannot contain spaces
- `projectNameInvalid`: Project Name must contain only letters (a-z, A-Z)
- `projectNameTooLong`: Project Name must be at most 30 characters
- `packageNameSpaces`: Package Name cannot contain spaces
- `packageNameInvalid`: Invalid Package Name. Must start with a letter, contain at least two dots (3 segments), and use only lowercase letters and numbers (e.g., com.example.app). Segments cannot be Kotlin keywords (e.g., in, is, object), and the template's reserved package (or any package under it) cannot be used.
- `packageNameTooLong`: Package Name must be at most 50 characters
- `appNameInvalid`: App Name must be 1-30 characters using only letters, numbers, spaces and . _ ' - (no leading or trailing spaces)
- `urlInvalid`: Invalid Base URL. Please enter a valid http(s) URL of at most 100 characters without spaces, quotes, backslashes or $ (e.g., https://api.example.com)
- `maxModulesReached`: Maximum 3 feature modules allowed
- `moduleNameInvalid`: Module name must start with a letter, contain only lowercase letters and numbers (a-z, 0-9), and not be a Kotlin keyword (e.g., in, is, object) or one of the reserved names (build, monetization, notes, account, sharing)
- `moduleNameTooLong`: Module name must be at most 20 characters
- `moduleNameDuplicate`: Each module name can be used only once
- `minSdkInvalid`: Min SDK must be a number between 24 and 36
- `iosVersionInvalid`: iOS Version must be between 15.0 and 26.2

## Anatomy (which modules appear)
- Always: androidApp, iosApp, shared, core/about, core/domain, core/image, core/logging, core/presentation, core/navigation, core/review, core/update, build-logic — shared wires Koin (DI) + Navigation, which are always included; core/logging sets up Kermit logging, core/review asks for in-app reviews and core/about shows the version, legal links and licences in every project, core/update checks for app updates, core/image loads images with Coil.
- `core/network`: if network (Ktor HTTP client; Coil network images)
- `core/designsystem`: if theming || multiLang (theme (palette + KtTheme) and/or LocalStringResources)
- `core/multilang`: if multiLang (i18n / localization)
- `core/database`: if dataStore (DataStore persistence; with theming also the saved Light/Dark/System choice (DarkModeManager))
- `core/purchases`: if purchases (offer / purchase / restore API, RevenueCat KMP (Test Store key: replace before you ship))
- `core/ads`: if ads (AdMob banner/interstitial/rewarded + UMP/ATT consent (test IDs))
- `core/room`: if room (Room KMP database (bundled SQLite): AppDatabase, DAOs, schemas/)
- `core/api`: if backend (the app's client models and routes for the backend API, checked by ApiContractTest)
- `core/auth`: if backend (Firebase sign-in (email, Google, Apple); the server client's token)
- `core/insights`: if insights (Firebase Crashlytics + Analytics; a no-op until the Firebase config files are added)
- `feature/monetization`: if purchases || ads (custom paywall (Compose) and/or ads demo)
- `feature/notes`: if room (Notes demo screen on Room (blank only; showcase uses Room for favorites))
- `feature/account`: if backend (sign-in screens and the account (blank only))
- `feature/sharing`: if backend (shared spaces and invites (blank only))
- `detekt/`: if detekt
- showcase adds: feature/home, feature/monetization, feature/onboarding
- each custom module → `feature/<name>` with layers: contract, data, domain, presentation
